capabilities: Publish a note with a command, hotkey, or file menu item
Publish linked notes and files with permanent links
Set social media preview images from note content or generated covers
Configure page meta tags from note properties
Generate a video from note text via Viqeo.tv
extras: The plugin is not yet in the community plugin directory and is available only via manual installation; the Viqeo video feature requires setting up an account and player and takes 10-15 minutes per video.
problem: Obsidian notes stay local, and the built-in Publish solution requires setting up a paid publishing site, while this offers one-command sharing of a single note.

relations.evidence: Create a video from the text of your note and publish it directly on the page (works through Viqeo.tv

summary: Publishing plugin that pushes notes to a hosted web page in one click, with permanent links, social previews, and optional text-to-video.
